{"code":"local floor=math.floor
local MT={fire={fire=50,water=50,nature=200,neutral=100,ghost=100},water={fire=200,water=50,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100},nature={fire=50,water=200,nature=50,neutral=100,ghost=100}}
local function resolve(attacker,defender,skill)
  local atk=attacker.atk
  local cc=attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local cm=attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pp=attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pf=attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local hp0=defender.hp
  local hp=hp0
  local shield=defender.shield or 0
  local armor=defender.armor
  local resist=defender.resist or {}
  local guarding=defender.guarding==true
  local selem=skill.element or 'physical'
  local nh=skill.hits or 1
  local td=skill.true_damage==true
  local seed=skill.seed or 0
  local power=skill.power
  local diff=attacker.level-defender.level
  if diff<-10 then diff=-10 elseif diff>10 then diff=10 end
  local absorbed,overkill,crits,done,killed=0,0,0,0,false
  local k=1
  while k<=nh and hp>0 do
    done=done+1
    local p=math.max(10,power-20*(k-1))
    local d=floor(atk*p/100)
    d=floor(d*(100+3*diff)/100)
    local crit=((seed+17*k)%100)<cc
    if crit then crits=crits+1; d=floor(d*cm/100) end
    local immune=false
    if not td then
      local pen=pp
      if crit then pen=pen*2 end
      if pen>100 then pen=100 end
      local ea=floor(armor*(100-pen)/100)-pf
      if ea<0 then ea=0 end
      d=floor(d*100/(100+ea))
      local m
      if selem=='physical' then
        if defender.element=='ghost' then m=0 else m=100 end
      else
        local row=MT[selem]
        m=(row and row[defender.element]) or 100
      end
      d=floor(d*m/100)
      local r=resist[selem] or 0
      if r<-50 then r=-50 elseif r>80 then r=80 end
      d=floor(d*(100-r)/100)
      if m==0 then immune=true end
    end
    if guarding then d=floor(d/2) end
    if d<1 and not immune then d=1 end
    local a=math.min(shield,d)
    shield=shield-a
    local loss=d-a
    if a>0 and shield==0 then loss=floor(loss*125/100) end
    absorbed=absorbed+a
    if loss>=hp then
      overkill=loss-hp
      hp=0
      killed=true
    else
      hp=hp-loss
    end
    k=k+1
  end
  return {damage=hp0-hp,absorbed=absorbed,hp=hp,shield=shield,overkill=overkill,crits=crits,hits=done,killed=killed}
end
local function fmt(r) return r.damage..','..r.absorbed..','..r.hp..','..r.shield..','..r.overkill..','..r.crits..','..r.hits..','..tostring(r.killed) end
local r1=fmt(resolve({atk=40,level=12,crit_chance=30,crit_mult=150,pen_pct=25,pen_flat=5},{hp=60,shield=10,armor=40,level=10,element='nature',resist={fire=20},guarding=false},{power=120,element='fire',hits=2,true_damage=false,seed=3}))
local r2=fmt(resolve({atk=90,level=3,crit_chance=50,crit_mult=200,pen_pct=40,pen_flat=10},{hp=300,shield=25,armor=60,level=20,element='fire',resist={water=-30},guarding=true},{power=100,element='water',hits=3,true_damage=false,seed=40}))
local ok=(r1=='60,10,0,0,57,1,1,true') and (r2=='137,25,163,0,0,0,3,false')

return 'ok='..tostring(ok)..' r1='..r1..' r2='..r2"}

  local ds = {}
  local dmin = nil

      local q = coreai_world_pos(name)

        if dmin == nil or d < dmin then dmin = d end
      end
    end
  end
  if dmin == nil then return 'none' end
  for k = 1, 8 do
    if ds[k] ~= nil and ds[k] <= 1.01 * dmin then return 'Tower' .. k end
  end
  return 'none'
end)
logic_define('wall_for_bearing', function(b)
  b = b % 360
  local D = 15 * math.cos(math.rad(22.5))

  local gates = {{'Gate_North', 347.5}, {'Gate_South', 167.5}}
  for i = 1, 2 do
    local diff = math.abs(b - gates[i][2])

{"code":"local function route(grid, teleporters)
  local R = #grid
  local C = #grid[1]
  local cells = {}
  local sr, sc
  for r = 1, R do
    cells[r] = {}
    for c = 1, C do
      local ch = string.sub(grid[r], c, c)
      cells[r][c] = ch
      if ch == 'S' then sr = r; sc = c end
    end
  end
  local tp = {}
  for _, t in ipairs(teleporters or {}) do
    local k = (t.fr - 1) * C + t.fc
    if not tp[k] then tp[k] = {} end
    table.insert(tp[k], t)
  end
  local dist = {}
  local open = {}
  local n = 0
  local function relax(r, c, keys, nd)
    local id = ((r - 1) * C + (c - 1)) * 4 + keys + 1
    local old = dist[id]
    if old == nil then
      dist[id] = nd
      n = n + 1
      open[n] = id
    elseif nd < old then
      dist[id] = nd
    end
  end
  local function pick(ch, keys)
    if ch == 'a' and keys % 2 == 0 then return keys + 1 end
    if ch == 'b' and keys < 2 then return keys + 2 end
    return keys
  end
  local dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0}
  local dc = {0, 0, -1, 1}
  if not sr then return {cost = -1, actions = -1} end
  relax(sr, sc, 0, 0)
  while n > 0 do
    local bi = 1
    local bd = dist[open[1]]
    for i = 2, n do
      local v = dist[open[i]]
      if v < bd then bd = v; bi = i end
    end
    local id = open[bi]
    open[bi] = open[n]
    open[n] = nil
    n = n - 1
    local d = dist[id]
    local s = id - 1
    local keys = s % 4
    local cell = (s - keys) / 4
    local r = math.floor(cell / C) + 1
    local c = cell % C + 1
    if cells[r][c] == 'G' then
      return {cost = math.floor(d / 1000), actions = d % 1000}
    end
    local hasA = keys % 2 == 1
    local hasB = keys >= 2
    for k = 1, 4 do
      local nr = r + dr[k]
      local nc = c + dc[k]
      if nr >= 1 and nr <= R and nc >= 1 and nc <= C then
        local ch = cells[nr][nc]
        local ok = true
        if ch == '#' then ok = false
        elseif ch == 'A' and not hasA then ok = false
        elseif ch == 'B' and not hasB then ok = false
        elseif ch == '>' and dc[k] ~= 1 then ok = false
        elseif ch == '<' and dc[k] ~= -1 then ok = false
        elseif ch == '^' and dr[k] ~= -1 then ok = false
        elseif ch == 'v' and dr[k] ~= 1 then ok = false
        end
        if ok then
          local cost = 1
          if ch == '~' then cost = 3 end
          relax(nr, nc, pick(ch, keys), d + cost * 1000 + 1)
        end
      end
    end
    local list = tp[(r - 1) * C + c]
    if list then
      for i = 1, #list do
        local t = list[i]
        local ch = cells[t.tr][t.tc]
        local ok = true
        if ch == '#' then ok = false
        elseif ch == 'A' and not hasA then ok = false
        elseif ch == 'B' and not hasB then ok = false
        end
        if ok then
          relax(t.tr, t.tc, pick(ch, keys), d + t.cost * 1000 + 1)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return {cost = -1, actions = -1}
end

local function show(r) return r.cost .. ',' .. r.actions end
local out = {}
out[1] = show(route({'S~G', '...'}, {}))
out[2] = show(route({'S.A.G', '#.###', 'a....'}, {}))
out[3] = show(route({'S#G', '.#.', '...'}, {{fr=1, fc=1, tr=1, tc=3, cost=5}}))
out[4] = show(route({'S#G', '.#.', '...'}, {{fr=1, fc=1, tr=1, tc=3, cost=7}}))
out[5] = show(route({'S<G', '...'}, {}))
out[6] = show(route({'S#G'}, {}))
logic_define('route', route)
return table.concat(out, ' | ')"}

{"code":"local S={units={},order={},idx=0,round=0,over=false,result='running'}
local function newUnit(t,team) return {id=t.id,hp=t.hp,maxhp=t.hp,atk=t.atk,def=t.def,spd=t.spd,skill=t.skill or 'none',cd=t.cd,team=team,shield=0,poison=0,stun=0,cooldown=0} end
local function side(U,same) local r={} for _,u in ipairs(S.units) do if u.hp>0 and ((u.team==U.team)==same) then r[#r+1]=u end end return r end
local function pickTarget(U) local best for _,u in ipairs(side(U,false)) do if not best then best=u else local a,b=u.hp+u.shield,best.hp+best.shield if a<b or (a==b and (u.hp<best.hp or (u.hp==best.hp and u.id<best.id))) then best=u end end end return best end
local function hit(U,T) local dmg=U.atk-T.def if dmg<1 then dmg=1 end local a=math.min(T.shield,dmg) T.shield=T.shield-a T.hp=T.hp-(dmg-a) if T.hp<=0 then T.hp=0 end end
local function checkEnd() local a,b=false,false for _,u in ipairs(S.units) do if u.hp>0 then if u.team=='A' then a=true else b=true end end end if not a and not b then S.over=true S.result='draw' elseif not a then S.over=true S.result='B' elseif not b then S.over=true S.result='A' end end
local function start(ta,tb) S.units={} S.order={} S.idx=0 S.round=0 S.over=false S.result='running' for _,t in ipairs(ta or {}) do S.units[#S.units+1]=newUnit(t,'A') end for _,t in ipairs(tb or {}) do S.units[#S.units+1]=newUnit(t,'B') end return true end
local function step()
 if S.over then return 'end' end
 local U
 while S.idx<#S.order do S.idx=S.idx+1 local c=S.order[S.idx] if c.hp>0 then U=c break end end
 if not U then
  if S.round>=20 then S.over=true S.result='draw' return 'end' end
  S.round=S.round+1
  local o={} for _,u in ipairs(S.units) do if u.hp>0 then o[#o+1]=u end end
  table.sort(o,function(x,y) if x.spd~=y.spd then return x.spd>y.spd end if x.hp~=y.hp then return x.hp>y.hp end return x.id<y.id end)
  S.order=o S.idx=1 U=o[1]
  if not U then S.over=true checkEnd() return 'end' end
 end
 if U.poison>0 then
  U.hp=U.hp-U.poison U.poison=U.poison-1
  if U.hp<=0 then U.hp=0 checkEnd() return U.id end
 end
 if U.cooldown>0 then U.cooldown=U.cooldown-1 end
 if U.stun>0 then U.stun=U.stun-1 return U.id end
 local sk=U.skill
 if sk~='none' and U.cooldown==0 then
  if sk=='poison' then local T=pickTarget(U) if T then hit(U,T) if T.hp>0 then T.poison=math.min(6,T.poison+2) end end
  elseif sk=='stun' then local T=pickTarget(U) if T then hit(U,T) if T.hp>0 then T.stun=1 end end
  elseif sk=='cleave' then for _,T in ipairs(side(U,false)) do hit(U,T) end
  elseif sk=='shield' then local best for _,u in ipairs(side(U,true)) do if not best or u.hp<best.hp or (u.hp==best.hp and u.id<best.id) then best=u end end if best then best.shield=math.min(20,best.shield+2*U.atk) end
  elseif sk=='heal' then local best,bd for _,u in ipairs(side(U,true)) do local d=u.maxhp-u.hp if not best or d>bd or (d==bd and u.id<best.id) then best=u bd=d end end if best then best.hp=math.min(best.maxhp,best.hp+2*U.atk) end
  else local T=pickTarget(U) if T then hit(U,T) end end
  U.cooldown=U.cd
 else
  local T=pickTarget(U) if T then hit(U,T) end
 end
 checkEnd()
 return U.id
end
local function ustate(id) for _,u in ipairs(S.units) do if u.id==id then return {hp=u.hp,shield=u.shield,poison=u.poison,stun=u.stun,cooldown=u.cooldown} end end return {hp=0,shield=0,poison=0,stun=0,cooldown=0} end
local function result() return S.result end
start({{id='A1',hp=20,atk=6,def=1,spd=5,skill='poison',cd=2}},{{id='B1',hp=18,atk=5,def=2,spd=5,skill='stun',cd=3}})
local out={}
for i=1,5 do local id=step() local a=ustate('A1') local b=ustate('B1') out[#out+1]=id..':A'..a.hp..'/'..a.stun..'/'..a.cooldown..',B'..b.hp..'/'..b.poison..'/'..b.cooldown end
out[#out+1]=result()
logic_define('battle_start',start)
logic_define('battle_step',step)
logic_define('unit_state',ustate)
logic_define('battle_result',result)
return table.concat(out,' | ')"}

local function rex(l) return coreai_world_exists('Room_'..l) end

logic_define('room_of', function(name) local l=ro(name) if l then return 'Room_'..l end return 'none' end)
logic_define('can_open', function(door,inv) local p,q,c=pd(door) if not p then return false end if not coreai_world_exists(door) then return false end return pas(c,pinv(inv)) end)
logic_define('reachable', function(from,to,inv) local f=rl(from) local t=rl(to) if not f or not t then return false end if f==t then return true end local a=adjof(edges(),pinv(inv)) local d=bfs(a,t) return d[f]~=nil end)

 m0=pick(ps,m0)
